Challenge [EDIT]

Urbanización Restrepo proposes 8 residential units in Villavicencio, Meta, with a reference area of 1,076 sq ft: a low-density housing cluster where house typology, site layout, and unit-to-unit relationships had to stay livable and clear in plan. [EDIT: confirm whether 1,076 sq ft is per unit or total; lot constraints and zoning]

Approach [EDIT]

The design was framed as a domestic-scale residential urbanization: site master plan, house typology, and presentation material (3D view, floor plan, and urbanization board) to communicate layout and design to clients and construction teams. [EDIT: confirm site-layout decisions, typologies, and finishes]

BIM contribution [EDIT]

Draft: BIM modeling and coordination of the cluster and house typology (site layout, plan, envelope, and documentation) to produce plans, sections, and elevations, catch clashes, and align design deliverables with construction. Confirm software, LOD, and the actual scope of the role. [EDIT]
